items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The actors, they love to sing. Jeff Bridges. All of them. River Phoenix.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. No, no, no. The record guy. He was managing Hall and Oates back then. This was 17, 18 years ago. Just partying. Hanging out and stuff, and dogging it up. Just a few years ago, about two or three years ago, Joe asked me to come – because guys send me their records all the time. The actors, they love to sing. Jeff Bridges. All of them. River Phoenix. All of them, all the time. They want me – they’re into music, and they’re an affinity in them. But Joe said, “Q.” He was there with that little Jersey sound.…
